children: Reference is made to the stock exchange notice published earlier today, 8 September 2026.

Lerøy Seafood Group ASA, rated BBB/Stable by Nordic Credit Rating, has today successfully completed the placement of NOK 750 million in a new senior unsecured green bond with a tenor of 6 years and a floating rate coupon of 3m NIBOR + 116 bps.
An amount equal to the net proceeds of the bond issue will be applied to finance or refinance green projects as further defined by the Green Finance Framework.
An application will be submitted for the bond to be listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. Settlement date is set to 17 September 2026.
Danske Bank and DNB Carnegie acted as Joint Bookrunners in connection with the transaction.
Ole Risøy, Head of Finance & Investor Relations

title: Lerøy Seafood Group ASA – Successful placement of new NOK green bond
